# canton_party (Data Source)

Looks up an existing party on a Canton participant node by its party ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "canton_party" "validator" {
  party_id = "validator::1234"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `party_id` (String) The party ID to look up.

### Read-Only

- `is_local` (Boolean) Whether the party is local to this participant.
